luna_price.mask_rule: all non-null LUNA prices in fit window

ust_price.mask_rule: all non-null UST prices in fit window

input_policy.forbidden_state_input: No observed future UST price, LUNA price, or LUNA supply is used as next state.
input_policy.interpretation: Calibrated feedback reconstruction conditioned on observed historical flows; not a pure ABM and not an ex-ante forecast.
input_policy.missing_event_policy: Outside confirmed source coverage, event channels are unavailable and inactive, not observed zero. Inside confirmed coverage, a null event set is represented by an audited event zero.

objective.availability_policy: Supply loss is evaluated only where direct native issuance evidence is available; price losses use the full May 1-13 fit window.
